title: Commissions
description: Follow each placement from hire to payout. Amounts are estimates until the client pays. Shares become owed once that payment is verified. Shares are paid outside Workatent and recorded here.

kpi.projectedHint: Hires not yet paid by client

otherCurrencies: Totals include only {currency} placements; other currencies are listed below and never converted.

empty.title: No placements yet
empty.description: When a referral ends in a hire, the placement and who is owed what will appear here.

detail.flashCreated: Placement created. Next: record the client invoice.
detail.subtitle: {candidate} · starts {start}
detail.platformVerifies: Verified by a Workatent platform admin.
detail.ledgerEmpty: Empty until a client payment is verified. Entries are immutable; corrections are recorded as correcting entries.

fee.title: Fee
fee.lowerSource: {partner} invoiced less than the computed fee. Your share is still based on the computed fee ({computed}) and becomes payable as the client's payments are verified. If you disagree with the difference, you can open a dispute.
fee.lowerTarget: You invoiced less than the computed fee. {partner}'s share stays based on the computed fee, so your share covers the difference.
fee.negativeTarget: Your projected share is {amount}. This is the part of {partner}'s share that the invoiced fee doesn't cover. You pay it to {partner} directly.
fee.higher: The invoiced fee is higher than the computed fee. Shares are never calculated on less than the computed fee, so every share follows the invoiced fee.

detail.negativeShareHint: Below zero because the invoiced fee is lower than the computed fee.

forms.invoiceDescription: The invoice you (the hiring recruiter) issued to the hiring company. Amounts in {currency}.
forms.evidenceDescription: Recorded as pending. It changes the ledger only after someone other than you verifies it against the bank record.
forms.verifyDescription: Only verify after checking the actual bank or payment record. Verification writes immutable ledger entries.
forms.rejectDescription: The recorder will need to submit corrected evidence.
forms.disputeDescription: The placement is frozen (no new evidence or verification) until a platform admin resolves it. History is never deleted.

messages.evidenceRecorded: Evidence recorded. It affects the ledger only after independent verification.
messages.disputeOpened: Dispute opened. The placement is frozen pending platform review.

validation.rejectReason: Give a reason for the rejection.

feeDetails.saved: Fee details saved. Next: record the client invoice.
feeDetails.title: Enter fee details

feePending.title: Fee details pending from the hiring recruiter
feePending.legacy: Terms not recorded: the hiring recruiter enters the fee.

how.deemed: no answer to the hire report
how.upheld: hire report upheld by a platform admin

feePending.noAmounts: Amounts appear once the hiring recruiter enters the fee details.
